settings.pdf.includeHeaderFooter.descrip: When disabled, text that the PDF marks as Artifact is excluded. At a page break, one unambiguous missing page-number tag can be completed from an adjacent Artifact page number. PDFs without Artifact structure are unchanged.

settings.pdf.backupOriginal.description: When enabled, one backup is stored in the hidden .pdfium-backup folder before PDFium Gate makes the first change to a PDF that does not already have a backup. An existing backup is never overwritten.

settings.metadata.hideFiles.name: Hide metadata files in File Explorer
settings.metadata.hideFiles.description: Hides only the technical PDF Metadata folder visually in Obsidian File Explorer. The files remain ordinary Markdown notes and stay available to Obsidian, search, and Bases.
settings.documentRegister.rememberFilter: Remember filters in PDF Document register
When enabled, column filters are stored in the current .base view and restored the next time it opens. When disabled, column filters are temporary. The default is off.
settings.advanced.diagnostics.name: Show diagnostics and debugging tools
settings.advanced.diagnostics.descriptio: Shows the diagnostics header in the PDF viewer and makes debugging commands available. Intended for testing and support.
